items.speaker: agent
items.text: Hello, thanks for calling. What can I do for you today?

items.speaker: caller
items.text: Hello. I am calling about something I set up with you, <1.5s> and I have a couple of questions about it.

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Of course. Go ahead with your questions whenever you are ready, and I will answer each one.

items.speaker: caller
items.text: First, <1.2s> how long does it usually take <1.3s> for a change to go through?

items.speaker: agent
items.text: A change goes through straight away while we are on the phone. The confirmation usually arrives within a few minutes, and the new details are in place from that moment.

items.speaker: caller
items.text: Okay, that's all I needed. Thanks, bye.
